rules.statement: A document does not comply with the requirement of being made by or under the hand of the President as stipulated in section 1.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. Document (P1) does not purport to be made by or under the hand of the President as required by section 1 (3) of the Appendix II of the Constitution and therefore, is not a valid conveyance

rules.statement: A document must comply with the requirements of Appendix II of the Constitution to be considered valid.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. Document (P1) does not purport to be made by or under the hand of the President as required by section 1 (3) of the Appendix II of the Constitution and therefore, is not a valid conveyance
